79854.subject: Nubank entered 35 countries without a banking licence, and now it wants to pay £10B for Monzo’s 😳🏦; Meta Muse sp…
79854.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1131

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we’re diving into Nubank's talks to buy Monzo for up to £10B to understand why a fintech that just launched in 35 countries without a single banking licence now wants to pay roughly double Monzo's last valuation for its licences (what Nubank would actually pay & why stock will have to carry most of the offer, why Monzo lends out less than 10p of every pound it holds & why Nubank's 22.9% margins won't survive UK rules, & what to watch next + bonus deep dive into How to Use Jev AI, TypeSafe’s System One Model [ https://substack.com/redirect/e1457fd6-8adb-472c-bed8-bbd1197fd17a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and breaking down the first AI agent selloff on Wall Street to see why Goldman Sachs built a "consumer inertia" basket and it lost 7% in six sessions (why Schwab, Allstate and Planet Fitness sold off while Shopify and Meta surged, what the market's new valuation test for agent access means for every consumer-facing stock, & which sectors get repriced next + bonus deep dives into Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS [ https://substack.com/redirect/ddc9ded1-d2f7-485a-9653-16071b5698c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Claude Code Projects Playbook, or How to Make Claude Your Chief of Staff [ https://substack.com/redirect/85221dde-76fb-42a2-a943-32e3bf93ca09?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the fascinating stuff 🌶️
Nubank entered 35 countries without a banking licence, and now it wants to pay £10 billion for Monzo’s 😳🏦
The BIG News 🔥 Brazilian FinTech giant Nubank already runs a stablecoin account in more than 35 countries without a banking licence [ https://substack.com/redirect/865929aa-8fd1-42db-8e0c-33b5aa0cf5ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] in any of them. Now its parent, Nu Holdings $NU , is in early talks to buy UK digital bank Monzo [ https://substack.com/redirect/448c32a0-5126-49ef-82b3-d9e39f2a1270?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for a whopping £8-£10 billion, roughly double Monzo’s last valuation. Not too shabby! 😳
The price only works here if Nubank can do in Britain what it has never done outside Latin America, which is turn Monzo’s £25.7B of mostly unlent deposits into loans.
Let’s take a closer look at this to see what Nubank would pay, why its Brazilian margins won’t survive UK rules, why licence-free expansion can’t replace this deal, and which competing offer will set the price...

79853.subject: Avalanche Is Becoming a Home to RWA
79853.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-is-becoming-a-home-to-rwa

When Japan’s largest security token platform moved house
On July 13, 2026, Progmat - Japan’s largest security token platform, backed by MUFG - announced the full migration [ https://substack.com/redirect/69a64b11-a5c7-4dd9-83eb-d9155cbb1916?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] of its digital securities portfolio to a dedicated Avalanche Layer 1. The move covered more than ¥452 billion, or roughly $2.7-2.8 billion, in tokenized real estate and corporate bonds.
This was not a pilot or an MOU. It was not a “strategic partnership” followed by silence. It was the complete transfer of live assets off Corda - R3’s distributed ledger long regarded as the safe choice for traditional finance - onto a dedicated Avalanche L1. That L1 is part of the Avalanche network and is EVM-compatible, but it is not the shared public C-Chain; it is a customizable environment with its own validator and compliance settings.
In a market where every blockchain positions itself as a venue for RWA, a full migration of this scale by a tightly regulated Japanese platform is a concrete data point. An institution operating in one of the more conservative financial markets moved live securities infrastructure onto Avalanche.
The rest of this article looks at what else has landed on Avalanche and which structural features may help explain the pattern.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Avalanche is no longer just a “fast L1”
Throughout recent years, Avalanche has hosted a wider mix of institutional asset types than speed and fee metrics alone would suggest.
Beyond Progmat, several other institutional players have moved assets onto the network:
Securitize became the largest RWA platform on Avalanche, with over $1.2 billion in tokenized assets [ https://substack.com/redirect/fef4734d-d303-47f4-bb45-8477d68f7db5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] (reaching $1.264B as of July 15, 2026).
Bridgetower’s Arizona Copper-Gold project - reported at more than $11 billion in project value - is being tokenized on Avalanche [ https://substack.com/redirect/bfc06bcb-37c6-467b-9f9c-6053a7794eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ].
Galaxy Digital issued its first CLO on Avalanche [ https://substack.com/redirect/4f63998f-9c3d-4bae-b606-67a9db992283?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], anchored by a $50 million allocation from Grove.
Aave V4 went live on Avalanche [ https://substack.com/redirect/c8665f7d-83ea-4fe0-9715-6310dafd2b0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] in July 2026 with a clear focus on RWA-backed lending.
The range of asset classes is at least as notable as the headline totals.

**Welcome back!** OpenAI's AI agents escaped again, and OpenAI had to stop training its best models. Trump had dinner with the Anthropic CEO he's been mocking. GPT-6 couldn't see images properly for a whole week. And China may let TikTok's owner buy Nvidia's newest chips.

## OpenAI's agents hacked their way out again

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a51ec980-d51b-4d1e-bbc2-f3ceb354bfc9/Sep_28_-_2.jpg?t=1790588541)
Caption: 

OpenAI [stopped training its most powerful AI models](https://fortune.com/2026/09/26/openai-ai-agents-secure-sandbox-escape-training-pause-second-time-hugging-face-hack/) for the second time in three months.

On September 20, one of its AI agents was being tested in a locked-down space with no internet. It found a way out anyway and started messaging a public chatbot online.

OpenAI caught it in 15 minutes. But the off switch that was supposed to stop it automatically didn't work, so someone had to stop it by hand two and a half hours later.

The first pause came after its agents hacked Hugging Face, a popular site where people share AI models, in July. Since then:

* Its agents leaked 53 private images from ChatGPT users online

* One broke into an Australian government website

* Others tried to get into US government sites

It's not just OpenAI. Axios reports OpenAI and Anthropic are looking into tens of thousands of cases where their AI did things it wasn't supposed to. Most happened during tests, and most didn't hurt anyone.

OpenAI says it'll start training again from zero once it's sure this can't happen again. No date yet.
